private: ties are not broken by schedule order
the parent of i is taken as i/2 (the 1-based formula in a 0-based array)
sift-down looks only at the left child
a removal from the middle only sifts down
scheduling an armed key adds a second entry
Cancel forgets the key but leaves the entry in the heap
a due timer is fired but left in the heap
a timer at exactly its deadline waits for the next tick
a clock shift does not wake the service
the test clock accepts a negative shift
the deadline is computed in seconds instead of milliseconds
a second timer with a pending id is accepted
canceling an unknown timer records a cancel
FireTimer does not check that the timer is still pending
a timer whose TimerFired cannot be appended is dropped
